title: Portfolio Health Monitor Input
description: Which actors to smoke-test. With no input, checks this account's default fleet.

auditPortfolio.title: Audit Actor maintenance metadata
auditPortfolio.description: Check Actor notices, public state, and deprecation state through the Apify API without launching the checked Actors.

actorIds.title: Actor IDs or names (optional)
actorIds.description: Specific Actor IDs or user/name references to audit. Empty audits every Actor accessible in the current account.

includePrivate.title: Include private Actors
includePrivate.description: Include private Actors when automatically discovering the portfolio.

runSmokeChecks.title: Run active smoke checks
runSmokeChecks.description: Launch the configured Actors with tiny inputs. Off by default to keep scheduled metadata audits cheap.

checks.title: Checks
checks.description: Smoke checks: [{"actorId":"user/actor","input":{...},"expectMinItems":1,"timeoutSecs":300}]. Empty = the built-in default fleet.

concurrency.title: Concurrent checks
concurrency.description: How many smoke runs at once (1-4).

memoryMbytes.title: Memory per smoke run (MB)
memoryMbytes.description: Memory given to each checked actor's run.

failOnUnhealthy.title: Fail this run when the fleet is unhealthy
failOnUnhealthy.description: On (default): any maintenance notice, deprecated Actor, or unhealthy smoke check makes this run fail so Schedule notifications fire.
